title: FairSense-AgentiX: An Agentic Platform for Multi-Modal Fairness and AI Risk Analysis
description: Open-source Python platform for bias detection in text and images and AI deployment risk assessment using LangGraph orchestration, a tool registry, and FAISS-backed retrieval over the MIT AI Risk Repository.
